user_messages: My name is Lin Che, and my friends call me A-Che. I live in Vancouver and I am learning pottery.
I have an orange cat called Chestnut. He is afraid of vacuum cleaners.
Please call me A-Che, not Little Lin. Coffee keeps me awake, so I prefer caffeine-free herbal tea.
Next Saturday I'll attend my first pottery market. I'm nervous.
My first pottery market is over! I only sold three cups, but a little girl said my blue star cup looked like the night sky, which made me very happy.
I forgot my handwritten price tags at home and used sticky notes instead.
I moved from Vancouver to Victoria. I live in Victoria now, so please don't say I still live in Vancouver.
Chestnut is no longer scared of the vacuum cleaner after gradual desensitization training.
Big parties have exhausted me lately. I prefer quiet conversations with two or three close friends rather than crowds.
I plan to attend another pottery market, but I want pottery to stay enjoyable, not become stressful business.
Next month I will make a birthday cup for my friend Xiaoyu. She likes green and dislikes gold decorations. Those are her preferences, not mine.
My own favorite color is blue.
